dataSource: City of Minneapolis CCS Permits (ArcGIS REST FeatureServer), queried live

coverage.type: Building, plumbing, mechanical, and residential permits

notes: Pulled live from the City of Minneapolis's public permit system on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever the city has published as of your search.
Matched by address prefix against the city's permit address field.

Minneapolis reports also run Tarn's Minnesota Code Timeline — a set of Minnesota-specific safety-gap checks covering electrical, structural, plumbing, roofing, and HVAC systems, drawn from MN Rule 1309 and 4714 — in addition to the standard national risk dictionary applied to every city.
summary: Minneapolis is covered by a live query against the city's public CCS Permits system, matched by address as you search, with an added layer of Minnesota-specific code-era risk checks.
